description: This file defines and manages language localization data and functions for the Mattermost web application, including language configurations, retrieval functions, and language availability checks.

methods.name: getAllLanguages
methods.description: Returns all supported languages, optionally including experimental ones.

methods.name: getLanguages
methods.description: Retrieves available languages based on application configuration state.

methods.name: getLanguageInfo
methods.description: Provides detailed info for a specific locale.

methods.name: isLanguageAvailable
methods.description: Checks if a specific language locale is available in the current state.
